name: Crystal Singing Bowl — Quartz Glass

material.name: fused_quartz

composition.notes: Optically pure fused quartz; free of metallic impurities that would damp the overtone series

material.notes: Extremely low damping — Q factor can exceed 10,000. The bowl rings for minutes after a single strike.

notes: Crystal bowls produce a much purer overtone series than metal. The high-Q resonance means the pattern locks in instantly and holds. At 432 Hz the n=2 mode creates four symmetrical standing-wave columns of water visible through the transparent walls.
cymascope_note: Lycopodium floats at water antinodes — four cream-coloured islands appearing at 90° intervals at 432 Hz. At 864 Hz (n=3, octave) six islands appear. The glass wall allows side-view photography of the 3D standing wave.
